Chummer public route guide

Overview
- Chummer is the public front door and support-aware release rail for the Shadowrun campaign OS preview.
- This hosted surface keeps current release status, future direction, public signal, and private support on separate routes.
- Signed-in account overlays exist for account return, support return, and follow-up, but the public pages remain readable without an account.

Primary routes
- / : landing and product entry
- /what-is-chummer : product story
- /now : what works today right now
- /now/concierge : bounded release routing wrapper
- /downloads : install and release rail
- /downloads/concierge : bounded setup routing wrapper
- /docs : governed document portal
- /docs/chummer6-quickstart : first bounded quickstart guide route
- /docs/chummer6-quickstart/receipts/publication.json : quickstart publication receipt route
- /docs/chummer6-quickstart/download.pdf : quickstart fallback PDF route
- /join/concierge : bounded invite and primer routing wrapper
- /join/primer : first-party campaign invite primer
- /status : short current release and support posture
- /progress : public telemetry and progress shelf
- /artifacts : public artifact shelf
- /artifacts/publications/{publicationId}/concierge : creator consult and packet-routing wrapper
- /testimonials/concierge : moderated public-validation wrapper

Direction and feedback routes
- /horizons : deeper readiness shelf and future lanes
- /roadmap : milestone-backed public direction
- /feedback : public signal and safe public bugs
- /feedback/operations : bounded public operations artifact for the feedback loop
- /changelog : shipped closeout and release-backed updates
- /ledger : public-safe Black Ledger hub for aggregate pressure and closeout motion
- /alice : ALICE build compare and Build Ghost public entry
- /table-pulse : Table Pulse live and aftermath public split
- /quicksilver : Quicksilver expert-speed command deck and jump-target lane
- /local-co-processor : Local Co-Processor hosted-first optional-acceleration lane
- /black-ledger : short alias for the Black Ledger hub
- /participate : broader participation entry
- /karma-forge : short alias for governed discovery intake
- /participate/karma-forge : governed discovery intake for table pain and house-rule demand

Help and account routes
- /help : first-party help entry
- /faq : public FAQ
- /contact : private support and follow-up
- /contact/concierge : bounded support-routing wrapper
- /home : signed-in return surface
- /account : signed-in account, account return, and follow settings

Reading rules
- Do not treat /roadmap or /horizons as shipped truth.
- Use /now, /downloads, /status, and /changelog when the question is what is actually available or supportable now.
- Use /feedback for public demand and safe public bugs.
- Use /contact or /help when the issue is private, recovery-bound, or account-specific.

Boundary notes
- The site is a projection of mirrored Chummer design canon, not a second source of product truth.
- Public signal, roadmap projection, and shipped closeout remain separate on purpose.
